steps.title: Bem-vindo: Listening - Volume 20
steps.text: In this B1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Listening". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: She talks fast, just like a native speaker.
She has a strong Scottish accent.
She left me a voicemail this morning.

steps.title: Desafio de Tradução
steps.question: Qual é a tradução correta para "native speaker"?

steps.audioText: She has a strong Scottish accent.

steps.title: Prática de Pronúncia
steps.text: Fale a seguinte frase em voz alta no microfone:

steps.question: She talks fast, just like a native speaker.

steps.title: Gramática: Passive Voice
steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "Passive Voice"?
options: The book was written by her.
This is the most expensive restaurant in town.

steps.title: Idiom: Break the ice
steps.text: It means: "To start a conversation in order to relieve tension.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: He told a joke to break the ice.
